author: ETA PRIME
description:
We are taking an old LCD Steam Deck and turning it into a completely local AI Agent—meet the Steam Deck BMO!
This project is fully offline, meaning it doesn't need any cloud services to run (though you can connect it to the web for weather and searches if you want). We're using a quantized 4-Billion parameter GPT model running directly in memory, utilizing the Steam Deck's CPU, GPU, and 16GB of RAM. I ported this over to x86 based on an awesome original ARM/Raspberry Pi project by Brynpoly.
Steam Deck LCD (Note: I used the LCD model because the OLED currently has audio/mic driver issues with this specific Ubuntu setup!
